blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–June Mar Fajardo moved five points shy of becoming the 19th player in history to reach the 10,000-point club after scoring 25 in San Miguel Beer’s 135-105 win over Terrafirma in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. Fajardo’s conference-high allowed him to move closer to the exclusive list, but he elected not to go for it during the fourth quarter of Wednesday’s game at Ninoy Aquino Stadium, with the outcome already settled. “We wanted to put him back so he can get that milestone,” San Miguel coach Leo Austria said. “But he wants to see his teammates have a longer playing […]...
